manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Lists the PDFs handed to this Brainstem and reads the text of one, a page range at a time; read-only, no network.
manifest.name: @kody-w/pdf_reader_agent

file.description: The PDF's file name from the list, or "" to list the PDFs available.

look_for.description: A few words for what they asked about, like "rent" or "start date". Fill it whenever they ask a question, so the answer is found on any page.
